IBSOFT_EXTERNAL_MESSAGING.TITLE: Meta template sending API
IBSOFT_EXTERNAL_MESSAGING.DESCRIPTION: Create and manage authenticated instances that receive external system requests and send templates through WhatsApp Business Cloud.

ENDPOINTS.TITLE: Instances
ENDPOINTS.DESCRIPTION: Each instance has its own type, channel, and credentials.
ENDPOINTS.TYPE_STEP_DESCRIPTION: The type defines the accepted contract and the integration instructions.
ENDPOINTS.NAME: Name
ENDPOINTS.RATE_VALUE: Up to {count} deliveries per second on this channel
ENDPOINTS.RETENTION_DESCRIPTION: Orders and messages older than this period are removed automatically, regardless of status.
ENDPOINTS.ENABLED_DESCRIPTION: Credentials from inactive instances cannot submit new requests.
ENDPOINTS.EMPTY: Create the first instance to connect an external system to a WhatsApp Business Cloud channel.

SGP_GENERIC.NAME: Generic SGP
SGP_GENERIC.DESCRIPTION: Integration compatible with the generic msg, to, and token parameter contract.

IXC.NAME: IXC
IXC.DESCRIPTION: Integration compatible with the IXC username, password, recipient, and semantic text contract.

ORDERS.TITLE: Orders and payments
ORDERS.DESCRIPTION: Define the default PIX data and messages used for order updates.
ORDERS.CONFIGURED: The default PIX data is complete.
ORDERS.WARNING_DESCRIPTION: Provide the merchant name, PIX key type, and key to accept orders that depend on instance defaults.
ORDERS.PRIORITY: Values sent by the ERP take priority. These defaults are used only when the corresponding request field is absent.
ORDERS.KEEP_KEY_DESCRIPTION: Leave this field empty to preserve the current protected key.
ORDERS.REMOVE_KEY_DESCRIPTION: New PIX orders will have to provide the key in the request.

LIST.TITLE: Sent orders
LIST.DESCRIPTION: Review orders and payments, and manually update items that are still available through Meta.
LIST.EMPTY: No orders were found for the selected filters.

SELECTION.SELECT_PAGE: Select updateable orders on this page
SELECTION.NOT_UPDATEABLE: This order is still processing, has an uncertain result, or has no message accepted by Meta.

BULK.TITLE: Update orders
BULK.DESCRIPTION_SELECTED: Set the new statuses for the {count} selected orders.
BULK.DESCRIPTION_FILTER: Set the new statuses for all {count} orders matching the applied filter.
BULK.ASYNC_NOTICE: The update will run in the background in safe batches. The history will refresh as Meta responds.
BULK.INVALID_COMBINATION: A canceled order cannot receive a captured payment in the same update.

MODAL.TITLE: Configure orders
MODAL.DESCRIPTION: Define payment data and the text used in updates sent to customers.

MESSAGES.DESCRIPTION: These texts are used when the integration omits message or mensagem. Use {placeholder} to insert the order reference.

TOKEN.TITLE: Endpoint token
TOKEN.DESCRIPTION: This token is displayed only now. Store it in the integrated system secret vault. Generating another token immediately invalidates the previous one.

CREDENTIALS.TOKEN_DESCRIPTION: This token is shown only now. Store it in the integrated system secret vault. Generating new credentials immediately invalidates the previous token.
CREDENTIALS.IXC_DESCRIPTION: The password is shown only now. Store it in the integrated system secret vault. Generating new credentials immediately invalidates the previous password.

INTEGRATION.TITLE: Integration details
INTEGRATION.DESCRIPTION: The integrated system submits semantic data through the contract below. ChatHub validates the fields, builds the Meta template, and processes the request in the background.
INTEGRATION.CURL_DESCRIPTION: The request must use exactly the GET method and the msg, to, and token parameters.

REQUEST.TITLE: Request
REQUEST.DESCRIPTION: Use the GET method on the module public URL.
REQUEST.IXC_DESCRIPTION: Use GET, form-encoded POST, or JSON POST on the IXC contract public URL.
REQUEST.IXC_SECURITY: In production, prefer POST so the password is not exposed in URLs, browser history, or proxy logs. GET remains available for IXC compatibility.

PARAMETERS.TITLE: Parameters
PARAMETERS.DESCRIPTION: All three parameters are part of the required contract.
PARAMETERS.NAME: Parameter
PARAMETERS.TO: Recipient phone number with country code and digits only.
PARAMETERS.TOKEN: Exclusive token generated for the endpoint. It identifies the account and channel.
PARAMETERS.USER: Unique IXC instance username. It identifies the configured contract.
PARAMETERS.PW: Password generated for the IXC instance and shown only after creation or rotation.
PARAMETERS.DEST: Recipient phone number with country code. Punctuation is normalized and 10 to 15 digits are validated.

PROCESSING.TITLE: Processing
PROCESSING.DESCRIPTION: Delivery runs asynchronously through background workers.
PROCESSING.ACCEPTED: A 202 response confirms that the request was validated and queued. The history on this page later shows the result reported by Meta.

GUIDE.SCENARIOS_DESCRIPTION: Choose a scenario to review accepted fields, requirements, and a complete example.

FIELDS.TEMPLATE_NAME: Exact template name approved by Meta. Accepts lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.
FIELDS.TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE: Approved template language. Defaults to pt_BR when omitted.
FIELDS.TEMPLATE_TYPE_SIMPLE: For regular messages, omit it or set it to simple.
FIELDS.BODY_NAMED: Value for a named body variable. Its name and count must match the approved template.
FIELDS.BODY_POSITIONAL: Positional body values. Start at 1, keep a continuous sequence, and do not mix them with named variables.
FIELDS.HEADER_NAMED: The single named text-header variable. Replace <name> with the name approved in the template.
FIELDS.HEADER_TEXT_ALIAS: Alternative way to submit the text-header value.
FIELDS.HEADER_PARAMETER_NAME: Variable name when header_text is used with a named-variable template.
FIELDS.HEADER_DOCUMENT_TYPE: Set to document. It may be omitted only when the URL path clearly ends in .pdf.
FIELDS.HEADER_LINK: Public HTTPS URL that Meta can access to download the document, image, or video.
FIELDS.HEADER_FILENAME: Displayed document name. When omitted, it is derived from the URL path.
FIELDS.HEADER_APPEND_PDF: Use true to append .pdf to the URL path or false to preserve it.
FIELDS.HEADER_PDF_MODE: Alternative to header_append_pdf. Accepts as_is or append.
FIELDS.HEADER_MEDIA_TYPE: Set to image or video. It may be omitted only when the URL path contains a recognized extension.
FIELDS.BUTTON_TYPE: Dynamic button type: url, copy_code, or quick_reply.
FIELDS.BUTTON_VALUE: URL suffix, copy code, or quick-reply payload according to the button type.
FIELDS.ORDER_TEMPLATE_TYPE: Marks the template as using the ORDER_DETAILS component.
FIELDS.ORDER_REFERENCE: Unique order or invoice identifier in the channel. Accepts up to 60 letters, numbers, dots, hyphens, and underscores.
FIELDS.ORDER_TOTAL: Order total. Accepts Brazilian monetary format such as 64,99 or a decimal using a dot.
FIELDS.ORDER_ITEM_NAME: Single item name. Defaults to Fatura when omitted and no item list is provided.
FIELDS.ORDER_PIX_CODE: PIX copy-and-paste code. Required only when PIX is included as a payment method.
FIELDS.ORDER_PIX_MERCHANT: PIX merchant name. It may come from the request or the instance defaults.
FIELDS.ORDER_PIX_KEY: PIX key. It may come from the request or the protected instance configuration.
FIELDS.ORDER_PIX_KEY_TYPE: CPF, CNPJ, EMAIL, PHONE, or EVP. It may come from the request or the instance.
FIELDS.ORDER_BOLETO: Boleto digit line. When submitted with PIX, it creates the second payment option for copying the barcode.
FIELDS.ORDER_ITEMS: Optional list. For each continuous index starting at 0, submit id, name, amount, and quantity.
FIELDS.ORDER_AMOUNTS: Optional financial summary. Total must equal subtotal + tax + shipping - discount.
FIELDS.ORDER_EXPIRATION: Future ISO 8601 date with timezone or Unix timestamp. An expiration description is optional.
FIELDS.ORDER_OPTIONS: Currency, goods type, and button position. Defaults are BRL, digital-goods, and index 0.
FIELDS.UPDATE_REFERENCE: Previously sent order ID. Also accepts id_fatura, id-fatura, or reference_id.
FIELDS.UPDATE_STATUS: Recognized status shortcut such as pago. Use it alone or submit detailed statuses.
FIELDS.UPDATE_ORDER_STATUS: Specific order status. Required when status and payment_status are omitted.
FIELDS.UPDATE_PAYMENT_STATUS: Specific payment status. Required when status and order_status are omitted.
FIELDS.UPDATE_PAYMENT_TIMESTAMP: Payment time. It can only be submitted with a payment status.
FIELDS.UPDATE_MESSAGE: Optional text displayed in the update sent to the customer.
FIELDS.UPDATE_DESCRIPTION: Optional description associated with the new order status.
FIELDS.UPDATE_TOKEN: Token from an SGP instance in the same account and channel that created the order.
FIELDS.UPDATE_IXC_USER: Username generated for the IXC instance.
FIELDS.UPDATE_IXC_PASSWORD: Password issued for the same IXC instance.
FIELDS.UPDATE_IXC_RECIPIENT: Order phone number including country and area codes. It must match the original message recipient.
FIELDS.UPDATE_IXC_TEXT: Required semantic content. Keep every update field inside it using [field]=value||[other]=value.

SIMPLE.TITLE: Simple message
SIMPLE.DESCRIPTION: Send a regular template with body variables and no media or order.

RULES.MATCH_TEMPLATE: Variable names and count must exactly match the template approved by Meta.
RULES.DEFAULTS: template_language defaults to pt_BR and template_type defaults to simple when omitted.

VARIABLES.TITLE: Variables
VARIABLES.DESCRIPTION: Fill a text header and body using named or positional variables.

RULES.HEADER_LIMIT: A text header accepts only one variable and cannot be combined with header_link.
RULES.BODY_MODE: Choose either named or positional body variables. Both formats cannot be mixed.
RULES.POSITION_SEQUENCE: Positional body variables must start at 1 and remain continuous.

DOCUMENT.TITLE: PDF and document
DOCUMENT.DESCRIPTION: Send a document through a public HTTPS URL in the template header.

RULES.HTTPS: Meta must access the URL without authentication, private redirects, or an invalid certificate.
RULES.TYPE_INFERENCE: Although .pdf allows type inference, setting header_type=document makes the contract explicit and predictable.
RULES.PDF_OPTIONS: Use either header_append_pdf or header_pdf_mode. Do not send conflicting options.

MEDIA.TITLE: Image or video
MEDIA.DESCRIPTION: Send an image or video using a header link.

RULES.FORMATS: Automatic inference recognizes jpg, jpeg, png, webp, mp4, and 3gp. Other URL paths require an explicit type.
RULES.HTTPS: The link must use HTTPS and be publicly accessible by Meta.
RULES.NO_TEXT_VARIABLE: Media headers do not accept a text variable or document-only options.

BUTTONS.TITLE: Buttons
BUTTONS.DESCRIPTION: Fill dynamic values for buttons defined in the approved template.

RULES.INDEX: Accepted indexes range from 0 to 9 and must match the button position in the template.
RULES.TYPES: url sends text that completes the URL; copy_code sends a code; quick_reply sends a payload.
RULES.MATCH_TEMPLATE: The submitted type must match the button approved by Meta.

ORDER.TITLE: Order and payment
ORDER.DESCRIPTION: Send an interactive order with items and PIX, boleto, or both.

RULES.PAYMENT: Submit at least order.payment.pix.code or order.payment.boleto.digitable_line.
RULES.PIX_AND_BOLETO: To show PIX as the first button and barcode as the second, submit order.payment.pix.code and order.payment.boleto.digitable_line in the same request. The system preserves this order when building the payment methods.
RULES.NO_SECOND_DYNAMIC_BUTTON: Do not submit button.1 to create the boleto button. PIX and boleto are payment methods in the same ORDER_DETAILS component; order.button_index only selects that component position in the template.
RULES.BOLETO_ONLY: To offer barcode only, omit every PIX field and submit only order.payment.boleto.digitable_line.
RULES.PIX_DEFAULTS: When PIX is used, merchant name, key, and type are required, but missing fields may be completed from the instance configuration.
RULES.TOTAL: Total must equal subtotal + tax + shipping - discount. Invalid totals are rejected before queueing.
RULES.ITEMS: Without order.items, the system creates a single item from order.item_name and order.total.
RULES.BUTTON_INDEX: The order button index cannot match another button.<index> submitted in the same message.

ORDER_UPDATE.TITLE: Update order
ORDER_UPDATE.DESCRIPTION: Update an order already accepted by Meta through the shared order endpoint.

RULES.STATUS: Submit status or at least one of order_status and payment_status.
RULES.AUTHENTICATION: GET accepts token as a parameter. POST requires Authorization Bearer and accepts JSON or semantic text.
RULES.AUTHENTICATION_IXC: Submit user, pw, dest, and text in the IXC envelope. Keep update fields inside text using [field]=value||[other]=value.
RULES.ACCEPTED: A 202 response means queued. An identical update already applied returns 200 without another message.

ORDER_UPDATES.TITLE: Order updates
ORDER_UPDATES.DESCRIPTION: All contracts in the same family and channel use their order route to update previously sent orders and payments.
ORDER_UPDATES.AUTHENTICATION: Use Bearer Token for POST requests. GET requests also accept the token parameter for ERP compatibility.
ORDER_UPDATES.EXAMPLE_DESCRIPTION: A 202 response confirms that the update was queued. The visible Meta message runs in the background and preserves invoice update order.

DELIVERIES.TITLE: Request history
DELIVERIES.DESCRIPTION: Track API acceptance, background processing, and status updates reported by Meta.
DELIVERIES.EMPTY: No external request has been recorded.

ERRORS.ORDER_DEFAULTS_SAVE: Could not save the order configuration.
ERRORS.DELIVERIES_LOAD: Could not load the request history.
ERRORS.ORDERS_UPDATE: Could not queue the order update.
